editorNotes.purpose: Original listening comprehension and oral-response bank for Level 1 Stage 1, meeting the approved 20-item allocation only; not the complete stage bank.
editorNotes.reviewNotes: Ten Explore and ten Extend items; each half contains five written listening responses and five oral prompts. The listeningText field is the read-aloud stimulus for this content slice, not a recorded audio asset. Requires editorial, pedagogical, and delivery-mode review before approval or publication.

questions.prompt: Listen to the passage read aloud, then write your response: What happened after Asha cared for the seeds? Tell one detail you heard.
questions.listeningText: Asha planted three bean seeds in a pot. She watered the soil and placed the pot near a sunny window. After several days, two tiny green shoots appeared.

source.reference: Newly authored listening script and response prompt for English Aptitude Level 1, Stage 1.
